notes.title: THIS IS IT!
notes.notes:
Hello peeps!

The day has finally arrived, we are thrilled to announce that from today we are slowly providing limited access to public testers to try-out our demo!

Due to some technical issues we can not release the demo to everyone at once but we are slowly adding more and more people as we move on.

Demo testers are picked from the ones who submitted playtest request on our steam page and will receive an e-mail in their inbox for instructions.

Try it out and let us know what you think!

Much love,
Madrain Studio

notes.title: Inside Information... Devlog #4
notes.notes:
Hi Peeps! 

First of all, on behalf of Nobody's Left team, I would like to wish you all a happy new year with exciting experiences ahead throughout 2024!

We are happy to return with some more updates on what's going on behind the scenes at Nobody's Left Dev room.

In the past month, we took our first shot for recording motion captures and cinematics using the Rokoko wears and I'm not gonna lie using this we managed to create some very dope animations and cinematics.

moreover, we were busy designing some of our outdoor and urban environments where unexpected actions are set to take place. 

We also added an in-game feature that we are not yet ready to fully disclose but it will make music lovers very happy!


And If I want to share some inside information with our beloved fans, I can say that our very small team of very few people is working hard enough to make a game that can compete with those titles that have teams of 2000 devs. for instance, our hardworking artists in the modelling dep alone have so far managed to create more than 4000 unique models for our environments all from scratch and we can not wait to share them with you all.

this was it for today and I will get back to you on the next one.

don't forget to wishlist and purchase nobody's left when it's released as it's an experience unlike anything that you have ever played before.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2370280/Nobodys_Left/]WISHLIST[/url]

Kind regards,
Ario Asgarian
Business Director and Project Manager

notes.title: Storyline Hints. Devlog #3
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hi Peeps![/b][/h2]

[u]We know how eager you are to know more about Nobody's Left and we can't wait either, but let's take one step at a time.[/u]

We have no intention of sharing the games storyline in details before it's release but in appreciation to your support we can indeed share some hints about what you will likely get to experience on our release date.

The storyline of Nobody's Left has been worked on for more than 3 years and reviewed and polished several times, it does indeed have realistic roots in it that many can resonate to. it covers circumstances that would destroy the capability of any human being to mentally function. we as the development team are very emotional about the story of Nobody's Left and we designed every bit of the game to transfer this feeling to ones that get to experience it. we did our best to make sure that it does not come across as boring or liner but instead engaging in a unique way like never before. it includes relations with one another and environments that surrounds them and their interactions in a post apocalyptic city where human beings tend to not obey their traditional mental models. it's through the incidents that the player gets to learn more about the game world and attention to details of each environment plays a big role in how much you can learn about the past and future of those incidents. 

have us followed and we promise to share more in the future. 
You can also ask us in the comments section, We will answer with more hints ;)


As always, Please show us some love by wishlisting Nobody's Left!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2370280/Nobodys_Left/]WISHLIST[/url]



all the best,
Ario Asgarian
Business Director and Project manager

notes.title: First Ever action-adventure shooter with MUSICAL AND EMOTIONAL STORY TELLING!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

[u]Today we want to share some important updates about the development process of Nobody's Left[/u]

We have received tons of messages and suggestions across our social media about the release date of the game. let's be clear, we have no intention to sacrifice quality for an earlier release, so please bare with us and allow us to deliver the quality that you expect from us.

the game is being developed according to plan and we are currently working on some outdoor environments! you must see them they look great! we are also embedding some interesting mechanics that are unique for their kind. 

furthermore, lets not forget we are aiming to be the first ever action adventure game with hyper intensive emotional and musical storytelling that will give non-gamers goosebumps. that by itself takes several exteras reviews and extra work as we are designing musics specifically for each environment and each momentum. 

if more, ask me what you like to know in the comments and-

Please take a moment to show us some love by wishlisting Nobody's Left! We are here because of those who love to see our work!

all the best,
Ario Asgarian
Project manager and Head of business development.

notes.title: IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091424/7d82a85ab082a7362cf730b90b8af69a82c1eace.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091424/74f06993a795164e89a2cd7d34cd707eefc06ce6.png[/img][/url]


[b]Important announcement[/b]

Dear fans and followers,

The growing community and growing support from our amazing followers has led to scammers and hackers targeting our game and mission more than ever before. we receive reports on daily basis about such cases and we are following the cases with authorities to find the people behind these acts.

meanwhile please keep the following points in mind:

1. We still have not opened an official discord channel and all links inviting you to such channels are fake and you should not click on them.

2. Madrain.studio and Nobodysleft.com are currently controlled by hackers and we have no active website at the moment, our only official ways of communication are currently our official steam page and our Instagram page @nobodys.left

3. do not click on any links sent to you on our behalf by email or anywhere else.

4. we will never ask for your personal or bank information.

5. we will never ask for you to pay or purchase anything unless earlier informed on our official steam page.

Stay safe and watch out for scammers that abuse our name and reputation.
